g.text: Predicts p, the chance that a departure's recorded off-block copies its schedule (|BLOCK − SCHED| ≤ 30 s). Depth 8,
learning rate 0.05, early-stopped on log loss. Reads challenge data only: clocks, recording process, arrival-side
habits, load, stand and runway history. Out of fold its p is close to calibrated (AUC 0.870): 30 % means 30 %.

g.text: pred = p · (d_sched + δ) + (1 − p) · blended regressors

text.style: font-style: italic; font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: The prediction is the probability-weighted mix of the two branches: the copy answer d_sched + δ (take-off minus
schedule) and the blended physical taxi. With p and the regressors calibrated, this is the squared-error optimum.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b
font-style: italic; font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #2a78d6

g.text: The same copy flag, fitted only on departures
900–20,000 s late, cross-fitted by month, averaged over
5 seeds. Mixed in as p + w (q − p), w = 0.75 at LIRF
Plan cliff, LIRF regimes, clock rules, plan-window

text.style: font-style: italic; font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e8a5f

g.text: Rules for known record faults, not models. The plan
cliff sets p = 0 when LOBT − SCHED > 3,600 s. LIRF
regimes split a no-plan departure into copy, datestamp
or real taxi with rates per cell fitted on training

text.style: font-style: italic; font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #2a78d6
